For every original FIT anchor, serialize the complete six current actor-visible public fields canonically with exact values and field types (not a reduced projection or hash-only match). Identify independent original-world groups using exact (family, seed) only for audit clustering.

Enumerate exactly the original physically performed legal selected two-action alternatives (original C35 nine pairs), with the original O22-Y safe seven-pair decision set for scoring. Verify actual pair IDs and source-selected outcome availability; never infer an unperformed counterfactual.

Build identity groups keyed by (canonical entire six-field current public observation, identical selected two-action pair). Only compare members from DIFFERENT complete source-world (family,seed) groups; report same-world repeats separately without independent replication credit.

A witnessed outcome alias is exact same public-current+pair but physically different recorded next public observation, returned front/motion/reward/terminal or progress. Preserve exact raw fields, type equality, and difference dimension. This is observational insufficiency only; stochastic-world and action-vs-time confounding remain unresolved.

Independently inspect original C35 archived predecision actor-public episode history metadata for each alias witness: require an uninterrupted authentic action-selected/returned public sequence BEFORE the indexed decision, with source episode/world custody. No reconstruction from the future, alternate forks, seed tags, hidden grid or discarded score. For each same-current-observation cross-world group, use actually observed safe-pair goal-progress outcomes to determine whether the source world's best pair differs between world groups and whether a fixed common pair incurs >=0.5 physical progress regret in at least one world. Resolve ties by exact numerical safe pair order. Do not use these already observed outcomes to fit or tune any model.

Count genuine independent source-world groups, same-current-state groups, shared-pair conflicts, authentic predecision public-history availability, full public-history differences, and actual divergent-best-pair regret witnesses separately for FourRooms and moving obstacles.
